findings.title: TypeScript readonly modifier added without local precedent
findings.body: The change adds `readonly` modifiers to the `CheckSummaryInput` type fields. While TypeScript supports this, the file does not previously use `readonly` in type definitions, so this introduces a new style inconsistent with the existing code in the same file. Consider whether the local convention supports `readonly` in type definitions before applying it.
